title: RAYE Leads the 2027 Grammy Nominations With 11
summary:
The nominations for the 69th Grammy Awards were announced on Monday, November 16, and women artists lead the way in the biggest categories. British singer-songwriter RAYE tops the list with 11 nominations. That ties a record Beyoncé set in 2025 for the most nominations earned by a woman artist in a single year.

RAYE's hit "Where Is My Husband!" was a chart and social media success over the past year. The song is up for both record of the year and song of the year, while her album This Music May Contain Hope is nominated for album of the year.

Close behind is Spanish artist Rosalía, with nine nominations. Her album Lux features her singing in 14 languages across a mix of styles. Rosalía won song of the year and album of the year at the Latin Grammys just last week. She has been nominated only four times before at the Grammys and has won twice.

Country star Ella Langley picked up seven nominations. Her song "Choosin' Texas" has spent 27 weeks at number one on the Billboard pop chart, the longest run ever for a song on that chart. Langley co-wrote it with veteran country star Miranda Lambert, who also has seven nominations. Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers have seven each too, and both of their albums are up for album of the year.

Of the eight artists competing for album of the year, only two have ever won it before: Taylor Swift and Bruno Mars. Mars is the only male artist nominated in the category this year. The best new artist race includes rock band Geese, experimental rock band Angine de Poitrine and alt-pop star Slayyyter. It is an eclectic list, spanning pop, rock, country, Latin and more. The winners will be announced in Los Angeles on Sunday, February 7, 2027.
why_it_matters: The Grammys shape which artists and songs get the most attention, and a year led by women artists shows how widely music tastes and success are shared.

background_read: The Grammy Awards are major music prizes that honour the best songs and albums.
Before the prizes are given out, a list of nominees is announced, naming the artists who could win in each group.
The biggest groups include record of the year, song of the year, and album of the year, and the best new artist prize goes to a rising act.
Artists from many kinds of music, such as pop, rock, country, and Latin music, can all be nominated in the same year.
